rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip code, matching a single user. It reviewed the user profile and orders with read-only tools, identified the correct pending order to the DC address, and obtained explicit confirmation before updating the shipping address to the default Charlotte address. For item modifications, the agent retrieved product variants, presented accurate available options, summarized the exact changes including item IDs, and requested explicit confirmation. When the user changed the payment method preference from gift card to PayPal, the agent updated the plan accordingly, reconfirmed, and only then executed the modifications with the correct payment method. Tool results confirm the items were changed correctly, the price difference was calculated accurately and charged to PayPal, and the final status and shipping address were correctly reported. No unsupported statements or policy violations are evident.
